_comment: Template configuration. Copy this file to config.json and replace the placeholder IDs and Discord settings with your own. Secrets AND database connection details (host, port, database, user, password) are NOT stored here -- they come from .env (DISCORD_TOKEN, CHATGPT_TOKEN, SIGHTENGINE_*, POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, or DATABASE_URL).
_postgress_note: The whole 'postgress' block is intentionally omitted. Supply POSTGRES_HOST / POSTGRES_PORT / POSTGRES_DB / POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env instead.

bounty._cooldown_comment: Per-group bounty cooldown, in HOURS, with THREE independent timers. The progression ladder (Bronze/Silver/Gold) uses 'progression'. Free uses 'same'/'different': 'same' when the same BBQ is repeated, 'different' when it changes. Event uses 'event' unless 'event_shares_standard' pairs it with Free. 'progression' and 'event' are one value each and ignore 'same'/'different'; an explicit 0 disables that timer. The Free timer is still driven by discord.latest_bounty_time, so an operator can move or clear it with plain SQL. Omit the whole block to keep 40/20/40/40.
bounty._event_shares_standard_comment: When true, Event shares the timer with FREE only: an Event run locks Free and the other way round, and Event repeats obey 'same'/'different' -- the 'event' value is then ignored. The progression ladder has its own timer and is never affected. When false (the default) Event keeps its own timer of 'event' hours.
bounty._progression_shares_standard_comment: When true, the progression ladder (Bronze/Silver/Gold) shares the timer with FREE, exactly as 'event_shares_standard' does for Event: a ladder run locks Free and the other way round, and ladder repeats obey 'same'/'different' -- the 'progression' value is then ignored. When false (the default) the ladder keeps its own 'progression' timer. Turning this and 'event_shares_standard' both on puts Progression, Free and Event on ONE timer. The no-repeat rule is unaffected by this switch.
bounty._progression_no_repeat_comment: When true (the default) a progression bounty that was already cleared cannot be submitted again: the ladder must move up. Bronze BBQ03 cleared means the next submission has to be BBQ04; the category closes once all 25 are done. When false the old behaviour returns and any BBQ up to the current rank may be repeated. Free and Event are never affected.
bounty._progression_gate_comment: What the Bronze -> Silver -> Gold gate requires. 'counter' (default) needs only the completed-bounty counter, which is the trustworthy record. 'either' accepts the counter OR the achievement bit. 'both' requires the counter AND the bit, and will block players whose achievement role was never granted -- check with audit_achievement_roles.py before choosing it.

_master_commander_id_comment: Optional. A Discord user ID that bypasses every admin role check. Leave this out (or set it to null) to disable the bypass entirely, so only the roles below can run admin commands. Prefer roles over a hardcoded owner account.
